snippet.title: Planets 2048
snippet.description:
🚀 Planets 2048 — merge planets and grow your galaxy!

In this gameplay video, I combine planets to create bigger and stronger worlds. Every merge brings you closer to forming the ultimate planet!

💫 Goal: Reach the largest planet in the universe!

🎮 Game: Planets 2048
🔔 Don’t forget to like and subscribe for more videos!
